content: Dr. LG is the founder and Editor-in-Chief of WikiDoc. He is affiliated with the University of Florida and the Richard C. Cardiology Fellowship Program at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Harvard. Dr. Jeffrey J. is based in Istanbul, Turkey, and specializes in chiropractic care. He holds a PhD and certifications such as CCSP, FACSM, and FICC. Dr. Stephen J. is an executive with FACEP credentials and is associated with Yale University. Dr. W. is a PhD and FACP, holding the Sondra J. and Stephen R. Hardis Endowed Chair of Cancer Genomic Medicine. He is the Chair and Director of the Genomic Medicine Institute and the Director of the Center for Personalized Genetic Healthcare at the Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute. Dr. David T. is a hematology expert affiliated with Harvard. Dr. Mark L. is a nephrology specialist and a Professor of Medicine at Georgetown University School of Medicine. Dr. Kenneth J. is a Clinical Professor of Ophthalmology at UCLA and practices at St. Mary’s Eye Center in Santa Monica, California. Dr. Nicholas A. specializes in orthopedic surgery and sports medicine and is based in Havertown, Pennsylvania. Dr. Robert M. is a Professor and Chair of the Department of Otolaryngology and Communication Sciences at SUNY Upstate Medical University. Dr. Steven D. is a Clinical Professor of Pediatrics at the Medical College of Virginia, Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine, with expertise in pain management. Dr. Martin I. S. is the Associate Program Director and Educational Director of the Plastic Surgery Residency Program at Cleveland Clinic Florida, Department of Plastic Surgery. Dr. Michel C., FRCSC, FACS, is the Program Director of the Cleveland Clinic Florida ACGME Residency Training Program in Plastic Surgery. Dr. Paul C. is an Associate Professor of Clinical Plastic Surgery at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine. Dr. Mark J. D. H. is the Chief of the Division of Pulmonary Medicine at St. Francis Hospital The Heart Center in Roslyn, New York. Dr. Robert G. is a Clinical Professor of Rehabilitation Medicine at New York University School of Medicine. Dr. Vijay S. is an Assistant Professor of Surgery and the Administrative Director of the Pittsburgh CTA Program in the Division of Plastic Surgery at the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center. Dr. Steven C. is affiliated with the Department of Urology at the University of California, Irvine Medical Center. Dr. Christopher J. specializes in vascular medicine and peripheral arterial intervention.
